description: Source code for managing DRX (Discontinuous Reception) resources in a 5G/4G network, including classes and methods for allocating and deallocating DRX offsets, handling UE (User Equipment) creation, updates, and removal.

classes.name: ocudu::odu::drx_offset_pool
classes.description: Manages a pool of DRX start offsets for UEs, ensuring an even distribution across the available cycle bins.

methods.name: du_drx_resource_manager::handle_ue_creation
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new UE, initializing its DRX configuration to disabled.

methods.name: du_drx_resource_manager::handle_ue_cap_update
methods.description: Updates the DRX configuration for a UE based on network support and cell configuration, allocating offsets as needed.

methods.name: du_drx_resource_manager::handle_ue_removal
methods.description: Removes a UE's DRX configuration and returns its offset to the pool.
